name: Lā that denies the whole kind
definition: Lā before an indefinite noun, denying every one of its kind: the noun is in naṣb without tanwīn.
body: Lā rajula fī al-dāri: there is no man at all in the house. Al-Ājurrūmiyya's conditions: lā comes straight before the indefinite noun and is not repeated.
If something comes between them, the noun is in rafʿ and lā must be repeated (lā fī al-dāri rajulun wa-lā mraʾatun); if lā is repeated, both ways are allowed.

examples.text: There is no man in the house (al-Ājurrūmiyya).
